statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder purchased an online photography course from 'MASTERLENS ACADEMY' for $149.00. The cardholder states the course content was poor quality and not worth the price. The cardholder feels the course was misrepresented and requests a refund. This dispute does not fit standard chargeback categories.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: The cardholder contacted MasterLens [12 days after purchase]. The merchant pointed to the course curriculum which matched the advertised outline, and noted the cardholder had completed 8 of 12 modules.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Medium — merchant may have valid defense documentation.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4854 (Cardholder Dispute — Not Elsewhere Classified).
